cdp.identity_keys.description: Maps emails, phones, source IDs, and other identities to a canonical customer.

columns.key_type: Identity type: email, primary_email, phone, mobile.

cdp.order_items.description: Order line items connecting orders with catalog products.

cdp.orders.description: Customer orders and order-level commerce facts.

cdp.persona_definitions.description: Versioned organization-level buyer persona archetypes shared by customers.

cdp.persona_inference_runs.description: Audit, status, counters, and checkpoints for persona inference jobs.

columns.cdp_id: Customer for single-customer runs; NULL for organization batches.

cdp.persona_snapshots.description: Immutable feature/evidence and inferred persona result for an inference run.

columns.inference_run_id: Inference run that created the snapshot.

cdp.products.description: Organization-scoped product/SKU catalog used by commerce and ML.

cdp.source_systems.description: Registry of external systems that contribute Customer 360 data.

columns.active: Whether ingestion from the source is enabled.

crm.agent_memories.description: Durable structured slots for coworker/agent context (not Redis, not CDP).

columns.scope_id: Empty for org-wide; else user id / cdp_id / deal id

crm.api_keys.description: Tenant integration API keys (hash only stored).

crm.companies.description: B2B accounts / franchise entities within a tenant. Required for B2B deals; optional for B2B2C contacts.

columns.id: Referenced by deals, contacts, orders, invoices, contracts

crm.company_locations.description: Sites/branches under a company. Every B2B deal requires a location.

crm.contact_activities.description: Unified contact timeline — emails, meetings, tasks, notes. Powers Inbox and activity feed.

crm.contact_profiles.description: CRM overlay on a CDP person — lifecycle, ownership, BANT, nurture/lifecycle agent state. Not the person identity store.

crm.contracts.description: Subscription/ARR record created on closed-won; drives renewal reminders.

crm.deal_activities.description: Tasks/calls/meetings logged on a deal (not the contact timeline).

crm.deals.description: B2B opportunity record. Stages: qualification → discover → propose → negotiate → closed_won / closed_lost.

crm.order_lines.description: Same shape as quote lines: order_id → sales_orders.id, optional product_id → inventory.products.id.

crm.org_assignment_settings.description: Org-wide rules for lead routing and ICP fit scoring.

crm.organization_profiles.description: Optional CRM-side vertical pack config. Industry source of truth is accounts.organizations.industry_type, not this table.

crm.privacy_requests.description: GDPR-style deletion/access requests — human must execute.

crm.process_confirmations.description: Owner approval before post-meeting agent sends email/proposal/close actions.

crm.quote_templates.description: Same pattern as proposal templates — org-owned document skeletons.

crm.quotes.description: Formal quotation on a deal; may originate from a proposal.

crm.report_snapshots.description: Cached JSON rollups for dashboard (avoids heavy live OLTP scans). Keyed by organization_id + kind.

crm.sales_orders.description: Confirmed order — from accepted quote (B2B) or direct commerce (B2C: deal_id null, contact_id set).

crm.sales_user_assignment_profiles.description: Per-rep capacity overlay for assignment agent.

crm.user_integration_connections.description: Per-user OAuth tokens for Gmail/Calendar (and other providers). Powers inbox sync and outbound mail.

inventory.products.description: Shared product catalog (all business types). CRM does DML only — no DDL on inventory.

platform.export_audit_logs.description: Who exported a CSV/Excel and how many rows.

platform.password_reset_otps.description: OTP for forgot-password (staff / customer / partner / reseller).

public.invoice_company_settings.description: Worktual bank details and invoice number series (one default row).

ticketing.activity_logs.description: Short human-readable activity feed for home/activity UI.

ticketing.agent_queue_members.description: Which agents belong to which queue.

ticketing.agent_queues.description: Support teams / queues used for routing and workload.

ticketing.agents.description: Thin staff bridge. Local id is used by tickets/sessions/notes. Identity (name, email, password, skills) lives in accounts.setup_users via setup_user_id. Never INSERT into MyAccount from Ticketing.

columns.support_email: Optional spoke email copy for mail

ticketing.audit_events.description: Append-only compliance audit trail of important mutations.

columns.name: Rule name
columns.priority: Evaluation order (lower first) — not ticket priority

ticketing.contact_profile.description: Support contact ops + customer portal credentials. No name / email / phone columns — resolve person fields from CDP using cdp_id.

columns.password_hash: Portal password hash (bcrypt); null if OTP-only

ticketing.conversation_contexts.description: Co-worker / LangGraph chat conversation state (active + parked workflows, recent history).

ticketing.customer_otp_challenges.description: One-time password challenges for portal login.

columns.identifier: Email or phone OTP was sent to

ticketing.customer_password_tokens.description: One-time tokens for portal password set/reset links.

ticketing.dashboard_metrics.description: Cached KPI snapshot for the home dashboard (one row per org typically).

ticketing.email_message_refs.description: Maps inbound email Message-ID → ticket for threading.

ticketing.kb_articles.description: Knowledge-base articles for help center / agent assist.

ticketing.notifications.description: In-app inbox notifications for staff (user_id → agents.id).

ticketing.org_api_keys.description: Integration API keys (wt_live_…) for website/email intake.

ticketing.org_settings.description: Spoke-only org preferences. Company display name comes from MyAccount accounts.organizations.company_name, not here.

columns.portal_auth_mode: How customers log into the portal

ticketing.outbound_email_log.description: Log of outbound emails (customer, staff, SLA).

ticketing.proactive_approvals.description: Human-in-the-loop approvals for proactive tool actions.

ticketing.proactive_audit.description: Proactive agent decision audit log (learning / explainability).

ticketing.proactive_embeddings.description: Embedding tokens for proactive search / similarity.

ticketing.proactive_outbox.description: Events consumed by proactive agents (SEMA / WLOA / TIAA / RCAA).

ticketing.proactive_routing_weights.description: Per-org learned routing weights and recurring-issue hints (RCAA).

ticketing.sla_policies.description: Per-org SLA windows by priority (what actually drives tickets.due_at).

ticketing.sla_policy_defaults.description: Global default SLA hours by priority (seed for new orgs).

ticketing.ticket_event_outbox.description: Outbound webhook / event delivery queue for ticket changes.

ticketing.ticket_notes.description: Conversation thread on a ticket (public replies + internal notes).

ticketing.ticket_presence.description: Who is currently viewing a ticket (collision UI).

ticketing.ticket_statuses.description: Per-org catalog of allowed ticket statuses (system + custom).

ticketing.ticketing_accounts.description: B2B client accounts inside Ticketing (companies your end-customers belong to). Not MyAccount accounts.*.

ticketing.tickets.description: Core support cases (the main work item).

ticketing.user_login_events.description: Append-only staff login history for the account security UI.

ticketing.user_sessions.description: Staff console signed-in devices / JWT sessions. user_id → agents.id.

ticketing.workflow_events.description: Workflow / agent event history (e.g. create-ticket chat flow).
